project_name: SIGCR - Sistema Integrado de Gestão de Credenciamento de Registradoras

design_philosophy.core_metaphor: The Control Center (Radar scanning for compliance)

hero.features: Large typography, orange glow accents, 'radar' scanline effects

landing_page.sections: Alternating grid layouts with generous padding (py-24)

dashboard.structure: Sidebar navigation (collapsible), Top bar for global actions, Main content area with breadcrumbs
dashboard.card_style: Flat, 1px border (zinc-800), no shadow by default, subtle glow on hover

hero_abstract.usage: Hero section background or feature graphic

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPORT FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to '/app/frontend/src/index.css' at the very top.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update '/app/frontend/tailwind.config.js' to include the 'Barlow Condensed' and 'JetBrains Mono' font families.

3. DEFINE COLORS: Update CSS variables in '/app/frontend/src/index.css' to match the provided Zinc/Orange palette. Ensure '.dark' class variables are set as the DEFAULT since this is a dark-mode first app.
4. REMOVE DEFAULT STYLES: Clear out '/app/frontend/src/App.css' to remove React logo animations and default centering.
5. USE SHADCN: Heavily utilize the existing shadcn components in 'components/ui'. Customize their borders to be 'border-zinc-800' and backgrounds to be 'bg-zinc-950'.
6. LANDING PAGE: Build a 'Hero' section with the 'grid_pattern' background and a large 'text-highlight' headline. Use the 'hero_abstract' image with a low opacity overlay.
7. DASHBOARD: Create a layout with a fixed sidebar (w-64) and a scrollable main area. Use 'bg-zinc-950' for the main area and 'bg-black/40' (glass) for the sidebar.
8. SEARCH UI: The 'Portaria Search' is the core feature. Make the search bar huge (h-14) and central, like Google or a command palette.
9. DATA DISPLAY: Use dense tables for results. Use 'JetBrains Mono' for data cells (dates, IDs, protocol numbers).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays separate good from extraordinary.
